Short video of the bike being ridden, showing gear shifts and suspension compression.

response.reason: The item is clearly identifiable by type as a dual-suspension, geared bicycle with at least one visible disc brake, but several seller claims (dual suspension, dual disc) are only partially shown, so it must be priced at the worst-case single-suspension, single-disc condition until closer photos or video confirm otherwise.
